notes.content: Due to high demand, admission to SDSU is highly competitive. General admission information is available at: http://arweb.sdsu.edu/es/admissions/transfers/index.html .
notes.contentHtml: Due to high demand, admission to SDSU is highly competitive. General admission information is available at:http://arweb.sdsu.edu/es/admissions/transfers/index.html.

notes.content: Complete with a grade of C (2.0) or better: E E 210 ; COMPE 160 ; MATH 150 , MATH 151 ; PHYS 195 , PHYS 196 . These courses cannot be taken for credit/no credit (Cr/NC). A minimum cumulative GPA of 2.7 is required.
notes.contentHtml: 1. Complete with a grade of C (2.0) or better: E E 210; COMPE 160; MATH 150, MATH 151; PHYS 195, PHYS 196. These courses cannot be taken for credit/no credit (Cr/NC). A minimum cumulative GPA of 2.7 is required.
